title: PlainPath Gov Extractor output
description: Structured, citeable service records extracted from public government websites. The full per-field structure is defined in dataset_schema.json.

results.title: Service records
results.description: One item per government service, stored in the default dataset. Each item has: site, url (source page), title (page title), service (service name), steps_raw (official step-by-step text), required_documents (list of strings), forms (list of {name, number, url, fields, pdf_status, pdf_pages, description, pdf_error}), locations (list of {name, address, hours, url}), fees (fee sentences), and crawled_at (ISO 8601 UTC timestamp).
